name: W6010 - Printer Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Printer output into the Unauthorized printer surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before sending content to a non-sanctioned printer (home-office printers, ad-hoc network printers). Exclusions: excludes printers in Printers_Authorized_Printer_Names_[is]; tune by populating with every corporate-managed printer (per-floor MFPs, secure-print kiosks) so legitimate printing doesn't warn users.
